meta.name: Online Learning Platform
meta.description: An online learning platform where instructors publish courses and students enroll, complete lessons, and provide reviews, with a freemium model offering access to paid courses and certificates via a premium subscription.

roles.name: student
roles.description: Can enroll in courses, mark lessons complete, and review courses.

roles.name: premiumSubscriber
roles.description: Has access to paid courses and certificates.

assumptions: Users will have distinct roles of 'instructor' and 'student'.
A 'premium subscription' implies a recurring payment model.
Completion certificates are generated upon completion of all lessons in a paid course.
